text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Why are you working on a<n>holiday?
choice_data_list: There's a lot to be done at the end of the year.
There's a lot to be done at the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... So, is there anything I can<n>help with?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't really have any plans, so...<n>I'm free.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about me. I don't have<n>anything else
planned for today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Don't give me that look. Not<n>everyone has a
festive day all<n>planned out, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I already stopped by a party, so I was<n>just going to
relax for the rest of the<n>day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You seriously need to learn to be<n>more tactful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you don't have to feel bad!<n>Come on,
let's finish up your work<n>quickly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You do even more work than I<n>thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You do even more work than I<n>thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I always knew you worked<n>hard, but seeing
all these piles of<n>paper in person...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well... It's a lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You really haven't changed a bit,<n>have you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I figured you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She chuckles softly and continues to<n>work.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She chuckles softly and continues to<n>work.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not sure if I should let her<n>help me for the
rest of the day. She's<n>been busy too, and she
needs a day<n>off...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Here, I'll take care of those<n>documents
nex—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? But there's still paperwork<n>left...
choice_data_list: The holidays only come once a year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Fine. We can deal with the rest later.<n>I'm still
going to help, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're right, we should have<n>some fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Not because I like helping you or<n>anything. I just
hate leaving things<n>half finished.
choice_data_list: Let me treat you to dinner as thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll help you with the rest later. Just<n>let me know
when you get to it.
choice_data_list: Let me treat you to dinner as thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You want to have dinner? With me?<n>Today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You don't need to thank me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But wouldn't that... I don't know.<n>Wouldn't that
almost be like a... I<n>wasn't expecting...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I've always been the one who<n>should be thanking
you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it's just dinner so... Fine,<n>I'll go. Eating
together's not a big<n>deal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's go. I haven't gone out for<n>dinner in a
long time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... I'll go change since we're<n>going out. Wait
here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but before we head out, I should<n>change. Wait
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Figures everywhere would be full.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Figures everywhere would be full.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to apologize. We<n>found a diner with
an open table, at<n>least.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It took me off guard when that family<n>called out to
me, though.
Then other people started noticing<n>me...
choice_data_list: This hasn't been a very relaxing time, huh...

text_block_list.text: Well, it hasn't been that bad.

It's not like before. Now I know what<n>those looks
mean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So don't worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I've been to a<n>diner, and I
had fun. I didn't know<n>they had such a big menu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: If you ask me, where you're eatingisn't as important as who you'reeating with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Saying that out loud was a little<n>embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Stop staring! Just pretend I didn't say<n>anything!
That's the polite thing to do!

But I meant what I said. I wanted to<n>make sure you
knew that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Anyway, happy holidays,<n>Trainer.
Happy holidays, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Here's to a productive winter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Here's to a productive winter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The restaurant was nice and relaxing,<n>and the food
was good, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised you even knew about a<n>place like
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it felt all... grown-up, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then again, I guess you are an actual<n>adult.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Can we talk a little more? Let's go<n>somewhere
quieter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: While I was helping you earlier, I got<n>to thinking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I do feel like you're a hopeless idiot<n>sometimes,
but... you're a proper<n>adult, in your own way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You work so hard I sometimes worry<n>about you,
but... you really are a<n>proper adult.

When I was lost, you pulled me<n>through and set my
sights forward<n>again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When I was lost, you pulled me<n>through and set my
sights forward<n>again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I was at my weakest and<n>doubted
myself, you called me strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Being able to lead someone like that<n>shows how
mature you are, and I<n>admire that.
I'm not. I'm just speaking the truth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
For someone who's always flattering<n>me, you sure
are quick to get shy<n>when the tables are turned.
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I just... think it's incredible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Always being mindful of another<n>person and
guiding them... That's<n>something only a real adult
can do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I still don't know what the future<n>holds for me, but...
if I'm going to<n>become something, I think I'd like to
be someone like you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to guide others toward their<n>own dreams of
becoming something,<n>someone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's the kind of person I'd like to<n>be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey... You're shivering. Are you cold?
choice_data_list: That's the best gift I've ever received...
That's the best gift I've ever received...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Stupid. That wasn't even a present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, stop it. I have an actual present<n>for you, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Here. You can open it, but I don't<n>want to hear any
complaints.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Here you go. I hope you like it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I open the present and see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's a brooch. It's small, so it<n>shouldn't get in
your way or<n>anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't have any special meaning.<n>I just saw
how it was glowing so<n>gently and... picked it up
without<n>realizing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And then I just happened to think<n>about you, so...
And... I thought it would look good on<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I hope you do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I hope you do.
Happy holidays, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober and I gaze down at the<n>sparkling
town below us, enjoying<n>our quiet night together.
